title: WIND-UPS ON THE USE BAR ONLY
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD and never repeats what is already on screen. Using a Bandage or a Medkit said Applying, a plate said Slotting, and patching up a teammate said Bandaging or Slotting a plate for him, all while the use bar under the belt already showed APPLYING BANDAGE or SLOTTING ARMOUR PLATE with its fill and seconds. Those lines are gone; refusals and results still speak.
now: Healing and slotting a plate no longer put a line in the feed as they start; the use bar shows it.

edits.replacement: G.bag.splice(ix,1); startPrep('heal',s2.itemKey); blip('pick');   // v16.xx (R29): the use bar says APPLYING
